limitationTriage.limitation: Single trained checkpoint does not establish cross-checkpoint or cross-architecture mechanism.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Can inexpensive independent training yield valid replication?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Short training feasibility pilots were attempted and did not yield adequate independent mechanism evidence.
limitationTriage.estimatedCost: Further controlled training and analysis exceeds a short publication repair; unknown compute cost.
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Failed feasibility pilots do not constitute replication.

limitationTriage.limitation: Fresh bank is balanced and history-excluded, not the unrestricted training distribution.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Can source-style unseen inputs test robustness without changing the checkpoint?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: New4096-row bank and portable native evaluation/recount completed; exact scope retained in prospective/README.md.

limitationTriage.limitation: The bounded input-bank test still does not imply arbitrary-distribution generalization.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Does the finite bank imply a universal generalization theorem?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Compared sampling grammar and conditioning with source; no such inference follows.
limitationTriage.estimatedCost: New theoretical or multi-distribution research, not a cheap checker.
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Finite balanced evidence cannot close the universal claim.

limitationTriage.limitation: Native and semantic endpoints, numerical rank, prediction and causal recovery are distinct.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Can precise definitions and counterexamples close interpretive conflation?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Review repairs define endpoint conventions, matching statistic, numerical-rank qualification and finite edit obstruction; claims remain endpoint-specific.

limitationTriage.limitation: A general causal semantic recovery or learning-mechanism identification is not established.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Do readout or intervention scores discriminate all competing accounts?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Checked mechanism distinction against Palumbo and Goodfire; finite scores alone are insufficient.
limitationTriage.estimatedCost: New discriminating interventions and model families; unknown cost.
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: No general causal-identification theorem or multi-model evidence supplied.

limitationTriage.limitation: Five image-dependent stages and18opaque pickle identities are not publicly replayable; one diagnostic log unavailable.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Can all historical bytes legally and safely be redistributed?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Rights and dependency audit; retained numerical inputs and explicit omission catalogues,18-stage public runner and scoped identity exceptions.
limitationTriage.estimatedCost: Rights clearance unavailable; no bounded estimate.
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Public accessibility is not redistribution permission; unavailable bytes are not validated.

limitationTriage.limitation: Three inherited architecture files require external exact-source setup.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Can public native replay proceed without redistributing uncleared code?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Explicit hash-pinned external setup and disposable injection tested; source/copy integrity checked; corrupt source rejected.

limitationTriage.limitation: Independent reproduction, formal verification and exhaustive priority audit are not claimed.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Do hosted CI or local replay establish those stronger assurance dimensions?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Separated manifest CI, local full available replay, bounded citation audit and AI-assisted review.
limitationTriage.estimatedCost: Independent external work and broader literature investigation required.
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Publisher-host replay and limited source checks cannot supply these assurance claims.
